title: The Week of Going Around

arc.title: The Cold Stone
arc.subtitle: a warm stone, already going cold

epigraph.text: A firing opens the kiln. A week of tending settles nothing. The hand goes to the mark before the fire, and to no shelf, no bed, no basket after it.
epigraph.attribution: A saying of the drying racks in Low Kiln, told after the first firing of a month

pov: Daniel Marchetti (Corin), close third-person past tense inside a body of two hundred and seventy-three to two hundred and seventy-five days, six months and ninety-three to six months and ninety-five days, carried everywhere in a basket and told by nobody. The surgeon's register colours the noticing — the file turned out as instruments on a towel and found exact, complete and worth nothing at two inches of air; the body inventoried as a wound of crust, gap, frozen thread, cold and afterdrop in the order they arrive; the held and empty intervals kept as objects on the sixth place and never promoted into a reach, a hearing, a seventh, a stopping, a payment, a held change, a key, a power, a doctrine or a rule — with no present-tense Chicago break and no tagged remembered line; the old life stays offstage and there is no departure from his eyes, no Court, collector, Waiting Room or back-room interior, no sixth hearing, no tenth stopping before the seventh year at its very end and still ungiven, no sixth asking and no witness for the row question (the five askings and the one further shaping stand as they stood), no tenth record-first hand, no eighth of the green or the shape, no third gap and no fourth likeness made a cause, no sign, lesson, mending or payer made of the first firing of Frost, no bond changed hands, no private record opened, read or copied, no figure given for the covered grain, and no ending.

scenes.title: The Fourth Morning
scenes.synopsis: First of six entries, the chapter's only \dropcap and the first \daymark{273}{...}: Day 273, Frost 4, Fourthday, Y.H. 813, the small hours under the Vail kiln-house roof into the first light of the working week. Open in the small hours with the hand laid down against the fold on the one hundred and twentieth answer as a man puts away a tool where the next hand will find it without looking, never recalled as a sign, growth, reaching, gift or power. No recap of Chapter 72 or 73; the reader has just read them. Carry the count from 272 to 273 exact, six months and ninety-three days told by nobody (T071/T072); the carried fire's fifth unpaid two hundred and seventy-three days, its payer unnamed (T088). Body inventory in the old order: one stiff leathery brown-edged barley crust two inches from the ear, gone past the point where a child would eat it, its empty place unnamed and no third; the thread of drool frozen in the dry heat and unwiped, because nobody under any roof has ever been given an instruction about the thread and a basket set down is a pot set down and left; cold stopped at cheek, temple and the bare wrist-joint where the wool rides back; the afterdrop waiting past a warming nobody in this house will perform. He knows the composed face that is not composure and that a cold patient cannot clot and will seem better before he is worse; he wants the crust lifted two inches. Both true, the second louder in a body two hundred and seventy-three days old, entered nowhere (T060/T086). Three counts in three places: the fire's four low pulls and the silence where the fifth should stand under the floor, the river's water over water at the finger's-width door, the boards' four nails, four and a thumb-width knot. Agreeing any two would want a payer put under both and none stands (T061/T082); the heard bell's four, four and a gap stays in the square beside the told bell of the Long Night and is not folded in (T078). Frost 4 comes on its own light, earned by that morning, and was not brought into Day 272; there is no market, Cross or bell on a Fourthday; Frost 10 (Day 279), the month's first Account-day, stands six mornings ahead and is not brought early. Sella goes to the fire before the basket and gives no instruction to the basket, tells the coals it is the thaw, turns them with the back of a broken pot, says The house will keep it where another woman would say I, keeps her finger on top of the shelf's front edge so the charcoal stays unread, sets the pot rim two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat and no look toward the bed, and lets the mark hang where it hangs because a morning and a hearth are not openings (T058/T079, T100). The first firing of Frost on Frost 2 stands behind the household with no lesson, mending, sign or payer; four openings in four months are four and not a rule; the next opening stands in a later month's first firing, far off. At the rack end the dressed grain lies under wool, turned once for damp and given no figure, the arithmetic that will read over it not knowing what it cost (T077). The yard goes around its seven walked-around places with a look and a wide step and no number, among them the returning-line place where a hand went in on Seed 15 and did not come out, carried and not named (T009/T013/T092, T098 carried). Garl stays in objects, his name unspoken two hundred and seventy-three days, the salt-stiff coat, hollow wheel-seat, proverb said to a pot and the tile debt neither paid nor settled (T009/T013/T092). Tarn takes the broom only after it has been instructed, says Yes, house to an early thaw and a late while keeping the late because it puts off the paying, keeps six in the worn thumb-mark and the seventh at the lip of the knife beside Garl's unforged collector sentence, brings the ear-sentence to the word that would call the loan and stops there as a remembered ninth stopping with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end and still ungiven (T036/T076). Jorra's men go low into the finger's-width-open back room before first grey and are given no name; his meal-fine grey dust goes past the bent finger, his bent finger goes into the cold damper ahead of Sella's unfinished sentence, the full note he knows three turns ahead is withheld on the near-full tray, the burned-slate word stands at four, the shut-room tellings at two and the pot sayings at three with the premature Smoke 14 note apart and no fourth likeness made a cause (T035/T031/T062, T065/T095, T064). First answer of the chapter: the hand outside the wool goes up an inch toward the river's note, takes the small intake of a count from the room whose floor does not touch his, holds it and comes down on the river's next low note, borrowing no house count and supplying no fifth; one hundred and twenty-one is filed on the sixth place beside one hundred and twenty, exact, complete and worth nothing at two inches of air — not a reach, hearing, seventh, stopping, payment, held change, key, power, doctrine or rule (T061/T082).

scenes.title: What Is Sent to the Pot
scenes.synopsis: Second entry of Day 273, no new dated heading: afternoon thinning into the small hours at the Clay Yard, the yard well and bare dark trough, the drying racks and the cool stone at the rack end, the kindling and flagstones, the wheel-shed edge, the back room as a direction and a sound, the loaf shelf, the bed and the towel. Afternoon thins without ending, the way heat goes out of a pot set off the coals; heat draws back out of the fold and goes to sit behind the pot. One leathery brown-edged crust two inches off, gap unnamed, no third; thread frozen and unwiped; cold at cheek, temple and the bare wrist-joint; afterdrop waiting past a warming nobody here will perform (T061/T082). Sella carries the basket at the half-pace from every open slate and goes wide around the seven places with a look and a wide step and no number: the clean dark line at the Vail corner, the finer grey hairline called the thaw beside it, the space beneath the lowest rack with its broken birth-slates, the round ring where the shallow clay pan stood with no scrape, crumb, print, chip or word, the bare dark trough beside the yard well with its water called weather, the field's empty place out on the worked strips, and the returning-line place where the hand went in on Seed 15 and did not come out. Seven are seven and not an account, because an account wants a payer standing under it and none stands; the missing hand is carried and not named, not paid, not joined to the shelf's two gaps, the fold's one crust or the dressed grain (T009/T013/T092, T098 carried). Frost writes white fronds on the well lip where the Warm has lately gone out and the yard calls it weather by noon; a wrong wind off High Kiln brings the sweet edge of lead glaze over the boards, touches the fold and goes out, a direction arrived nowhere with no fourth likeness made a cause (T083/T085, T064). A woman with a pot asks what the keeping and storing will take now the grain is under wool and the visits coming and is sent to the pot and the weather; a man come down the clay road with dried pale scurf of mud on his coat skirt brings a number up out of a fist toward the well, looks at it and puts it back into his sleeve, so the figure arrives nowhere — a figure read is still not a figure paid (T077, T015/T041/T047). The dressed grain is turned once beneath the wool for damp with a lighter touch and set back, changed in state and given no figure, the space between figure and price unsigned (T077). At the loaf shelf Sella keeps her finger on top of the front edge so the charcoal tally on the underside stays unread, moves her lips along a row standing with two gaps and gives neither gap a figure, glances once at the clay jar standing cold under its lead glaze and shuts her hand half over nothing, sets the pot rim two inches out with a half-beat and no look toward the bed, and gives no instruction at any hour to the basket (T100, T058/T079). At the going of the light she carries him up at the half-pace, sets him on the bed under the roof and not in the Debt Loft, puts the fold right without a look at his face and leaves the thread frozen. In the small hours the file is turned out on the towel and found exact, complete and worth nothing at two inches of air: six hearings beside and never among with no seventh, the premature note on its own place, the burned slate at four, the two shut-room tellings at two, three pot sayings with no fourth likeness, five askings with one shaping and no witness, nine stoppings with no tenth, nine record-first hands with a finger between every pair, the held interval and the empty interval on the sixth place with a finger between, and every gap left gap (T061/T082, T080, T101, T036/T076). Second answer: the hand goes up an inch, takes the small intake and the hold of one of the breaths counted in the next room, comes down BEFORE that count's letting-go, and leaves the little silence after it whole and empty on a place of its own, not crossed and not filled; one hundred and twenty-two is filed beside one hundred and twenty-one, exact, complete and worth nothing at two inches of air (T061/T082).

scenes.title: The Held Beat Returns
scenes.synopsis: Third entry, third dated \daymark{274}{...}: Day 274, Frost 5, Fifthday, Y.H. 813, the small hours into the morning under the Vail roof and out onto the Clay Yard. New day, new date, no recap. Frost 5 comes on its own morning, earned by that light, and was not brought into Day 273; there is no market, Cross or bell on a Fifthday; Frost 10 stands five mornings ahead and is not brought early. Carry 273 to 274 exact, six months and ninety-four days told by nobody (T071/T072); the carried fire's fifth unpaid two hundred and seventy-four days, its payer unnamed (T088). First smells as before: hot clay cooled under tallow, wet wool, the sour breath of the unswept corner called the thaw; rime lies heavier on the well lip; the kiln answers in fours with its gap, not a bell; the river keeps water over water; the boards keep four nails, four and a knot. Sella's grammar holds exactly: fire before basket, instruction to the fire, the wool, the pot, the broom and the running water and never to the basket, The house will keep it where another woman would say I, half-pace from every open slate, pot handle two inches out, fold put right without a look at his face, thread left frozen, the mark untouched because a morning, a hearth and a rack are not openings (T058/T079). The dressed grain is turned beneath the wool for damp and given no figure; Smoke's third arithmetic stays behind and unread up the clay road in Berr's locked box and the figure read is still not the figure paid (T077, T015/T041/T047). THE CHAPTER'S ONE MEANINGFUL CHANGE, ADVANCED AND NOT PAID: at the loaf shelf, standing with her back to the basket and moving her lips along the row with its two gaps, Sella's finger goes BENEATH the front edge where the charcoal tally lies and stays for the length of TWO of the breaths she counts under her breath, instead of the one of Day 166, then comes away without looking at it, without a word and without going back; the charcoal is not read, copied, counted or joined to the two gaps above. The boy files the returned held beat on the shelf's own place, beside the Day 161 fraction at the damper, the Day 166 held beat and the Tallow 22 flagstone half-check, not as a new place, not as a fourth likeness standing up as a cause, not a reading, not a payment, with no payer named; a house can change by two breaths and say nothing, and the not-saying is kept on a place of its own (T100, T061/T082). Tarn takes the broom only after it is instructed, says Yes, house to an early and a late thaw and keeps the late because it puts off the paying, keeps six counted where the house can check and the seventh at the very lip of the sill where it cannot, brings the ear-sentence to the word that would call the loan and stops there as a remembered ninth stopping with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end and still ungiven, the Seed 16 breath unspent, his chest tight, Ash worked into the knuckle creases, the pale clip-ring holding what light there is, and the warm stone in its unmarked loft pot cold and unreconciled by not trying, reached only as a sound with a direction (T036/T076, T006). Before first grey men unnamed go low into the back room; Jorra comes through with meal-fine grey slate dust past the bent finger, parts dusty forearms from clean, speaks to the wheel before any person and tells a pot You'll do, withholds on the near-full tray the full note he knows three turns ahead with air under it and a want in it, and puts that bent finger into the cold damper ahead of Sella's unfinished sentence, one iron with two bites and no Grathic word for both, joined to no kiln; the burned slate stays at four, the shut-room tellings at two, the promise of the boy's name neither given nor withdrawn (T035/T031/T062, T065/T095). Third answer: the hand goes up an inch, takes the small intake and the hold of a counted breath in the next room, stays past that count's letting-go and through the little silence after it, and comes down on the river's next low note, carrying one of the house's rhythms across the interval with no second house count borrowed and no fifth supplied to the kiln; one hundred and twenty-three is filed on the sixth place, exact, complete and worth nothing at two inches of air (T061/T082).

scenes.title: The Count Kept in Wood
scenes.synopsis: Fourth entry of Day 274, no new dated heading: afternoon at the yard well, the bare trough and the drying racks, the flagstones and the wheel-shed edge, into the small hours at the bed and the towel. Afternoon thins without ending. One crust two inches off with its unnamed gap and no third; thread frozen; cold at cheek, temple and wrist; afterdrop waiting past a warming nobody here will perform (T061/T082). Ilva is glimpsed once at the yard well drawing water with the pail against her knee, clay dried pale in the crescents of her nails and the finer grey rack dust worked into the seam of one thumb, which she does not scrub out. Asked what the month's firings have taken, her hand goes toward her sleeve and stays there; the short strip of notched birch is not taken out, read, asked about, taken a figure from or joined to the charcoal under the shelf, the cord, the knots, the pages, the tins, the missing hand or the pale line. Her eyes go to the asker and her mouth answers the question put and not the one behind it: Ask the pot what it cost. I keep the count, not the account. She goes on with her water and nobody turns twice. The boy files no tenth record-first hand; the ninth stays on its own place with a finger between it and the eighth, the count stays in wood where no slate can take a figure off it, and she does not know she was read (T080 held at nine, not paid). The shallow bright patch on the flagstones is kept as it has been since Seed 22, and the broom stroke goes over it without the half-check, the stones still keeping the place where it stopped; the loft scrape on its own place and the carried man's pale line on another are not joined to it (T036/T076). Jorra's forearms carry meal-fine grey dust and he asks no question that would join them to a cause; the back room keeps its finger's width of open and its sound of low voices and gets no name from the house; the burned-slate word is a direction over the boards told four times and not a fifth telling, the two shut-room tellings stay two, the three pot sayings keep the premature Smoke 14 note apart with no fourth likeness made a cause, and the row question stands at five askings with one shaping and no witness — no sixth asking comes and no new shaping, and the ownerless voice is not heard over the boards (T035/T031/T062, T065/T095, T101, T064). The pan's gone ring, the two shelf gaps in the room that does not touch his, the fold's one crust with its empty place, the field's empty place and the hand that did not come back stay on separate places; no third gap comes and no fourth likeness is made a cause (T060/T086, T098 carried). A child's foot below the sill stays wrapped in a woman's wool, called the cold by her and weather by the yard, the extremity going before the core and the afterdrop waiting, with no silt-leach, cause or cure named (T093/T094). Fourth answer: the hand goes up an inch toward the river's note, takes the small intake of one of the counted breaths in the next room and the small intake of the next one, holds the two intakes apart with a finger between them, leaves the letting-go between them where it was, and comes down on the river's next low note; the two intakes lie as two objects and not one rhythm, no house count is borrowed, no fifth is supplied, and one hundred and twenty-four is filed on the sixth place exact, complete and worth nothing at two inches of air (T061/T082).

scenes.title: The Letting-Go Left Where It Lay
scenes.synopsis: Fifth entry, fifth dated \daymark{275}{...}: Day 275, Frost 6, Sixthday, Y.H. 813, the small hours into the morning under the Vail roof and out onto the Clay Yard and the rack end. New day, new date, no recap. Frost 6 comes on its own morning, earned by that light, and was not brought into Day 274; there is no market, Cross or bell on a Sixthday; Frost 10 stands four mornings ahead and is not brought early. Carry 274 to 275 exact, six months and ninety-five days told by nobody (T071/T072); the carried fire's fifth unpaid two hundred and seventy-five days, its payer unnamed (T088). First smells and sounds as before, with rime on the step and the river low over lower under the finger's-width door. Sella's grammar holds exactly: fire before basket, instruction to the fire, the wool, the pot, the broom and the running water and never to the basket, The house will keep it, half-pace from every open slate, pot handle two inches out with a half-beat and no look toward the bed, fold put right without a look at his face, thread left frozen, finger on top of the shelf's front edge so the charcoal stays unread, and the widow's mark untouched at a morning, a hearth, a rack and a basket, because none is an opening (T058/T079, T100). The dressed grain is turned once beneath the wool with a lighter touch and given no figure, the covered thing still lying on the cool stone at the rack end with the arithmetic to come not knowing what it cost (T077). The first firing of Frost is not looked at again as a sign, lesson, mending or payment, and the household's refusal to make a doctrine of four months' openings is kept as a finding with no payer, not laid across the house's not-doings or his own kept gaps, for a joining would want a payer and none stands (T058/T079, T061/T082). Garl is kept in objects and not in a story, his name unspoken two hundred and seventy-five days, the salt-stiff coat with the left-shoulder crease, the hollow wheel-seat Sella will let nobody fill, the proverb gone to a pot with no crack, and the tile debt neither paid nor settled nor done with; no collector came up the clay road on Frost 4, 5 or 6 and none went down it (T009/T013/T092). The seven walked-around places are gone around with a look and a wide step and no number, including the returning-line place where the hand went in on Seed 15 and did not come out, carried and not named (T098). Tarn takes the broom only after it has been instructed, says Yes, house to the early and the late thaw and keeps the late, keeps six where the house can check and the seventh at the lip where it cannot, brings the ear-sentence to the calling word and stops there as a remembered ninth stopping with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end and still ungiven, the Seed 16 breath unspent, the loan uncalled in the ruts, his stroke going over the bright patch without the half-check; the warm stone in the loft pot stays cold and unreconciled, reaching him only as a small dry sound with a direction (T036/T076, T006). Jorra parts dusty forearms from clean as a surgeon parts clot from vessel, speaks to the wheel and a pot before any person, withholds the note he knows three turns ahead, and puts his bent finger into the cold damper ahead of Sella's unfinished sentence; the burned slate stays at four, the shut-room tellings at two, the three pot sayings with the Smoke 14 note apart and no fourth likeness made a cause, and his promise of the boy's name is neither given nor withdrawn (T035/T031/T062, T065/T095). Fifth answer: the hand goes up an inch, takes the small intake and the hold of a counted breath in the next room, and comes down on the river's next low note WHILE that house's count is still letting go, so that the letting-go stays outside the holding and is entered nowhere; a separation is made by ending early rather than by filling, borrowing no house count and supplying no fifth, and one hundred and twenty-five is filed on the sixth place exact, complete and worth nothing at two inches of air (T061/T082). The two intakes held apart on one of the earlier places stay where they were laid, and no likeness between them and the early ending is made a cause.

scenes.title: The File Left Open
scenes.synopsis: Sixth and final entry, chapter close, no new dated heading: Day 275, Frost 6, afternoon into the small hours at the Clay Yard, the kindling and flagstones, the wheel-shed edge, the back room as a direction and a sound, the clay road at the going of the light, the bed, the boards and the towel. Frost goes out without a boundary drawn and neither of the district's two habits of naming the months is set right or left wrong; no lesson is made of four months' openings and the next opening stands in the first firing of a later month, far off. Afternoon thins without ending; heat draws back from the fold; one leathery brown-edged crust two inches off with its unnamed gap and no third; thread frozen and unwiped; cold at cheek, temple and the bare wrist-joint; afterdrop waiting past a warming nobody here will perform (T061/T082). Garl is kept by objects, a keeping and not a story, his name unspoken two hundred and seventy-five days, the uncalled tile debt worse for being uncalled, and no collector up or down the clay road on Frost 4, 5 or 6 (T009/T013/T092). The seven walked-around places are gone around with a look and a wide step and no number, the returning-line hand carried and not named (T098). Sella carries him up at the going of the light at the half-pace from every open slate, sets him on the bed under the roof and not in the Debt Loft, puts the fold right without a look at his face and leaves the thread frozen, tells the fire it was the thaw, turns the coals with the back of a broken pot, says The house will keep it where another woman would say I, keeps her finger on top of the shelf's front edge so the charcoal stays unread, moves her lips along a row standing with two gaps and gives neither gap a figure, glances once at the clay jar standing cold under its lead glaze and shuts her hand half over nothing, sets the pot rim two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat and no look toward the bed, and gives no instruction at any hour to the basket (T058/T079, T100). The widow's mark hangs where it hangs, touched once before the kiln on Frost 2 and at no shelf, well, rack, road, basket, yard, morning, hearth, afternoon, dusk or going of the light on Frost 4, 5 or 6, because none of these is an opening; the first firing of Frost stands behind the household with no lesson, sign, mending or payer (T058/T079). In the small hours the file is turned out on the towel and found exact, complete and worth nothing at two inches of air: six hearings beside and never among with no seventh, the premature note on its own place, the burned-slate word at four as a direction and not a fifth telling, the two shut-room tellings at two, three pot sayings with no fourth likeness, five askings with one shaping and no witness, nine stoppings with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end and still ungiven, nine record-first hands with Ilva's ninth unread and no tenth, the seventh green a colour and the seventh shape a shape with no eighth, the heard bell beside the told with its gap left in the square, and Smoke's third arithmetic locked in Berr's box and unread with the figure read still not the figure paid (T061/T082, T080, T101, T036/T076, T050/T051, T033/T034, T078, T015/T041/T047). The held interval and the empty interval lie side by side on the sixth place with a finger between, and neither is made to agree with the fire's missing fifth, for agreeing any two would want a payer and none stands. Sixth and final answer: the hand goes up an inch toward the river's note, takes the small intake and the hold of a count from the room whose floor does not touch his, stays past its letting-go and through the little silence after it, sets the held interval and the empty interval side by side with a finger between, borrows no house count, supplies no fifth to the kiln, takes nothing from the two-gapped row and comes down on the river's next low note; one hundred and twenty-six is filed on the sixth place beside one hundred and twenty-five, exact, complete and worth nothing at two inches of air — an honest coordination and not a reach, hearing, seventh, stopping, payment, held change, key, power, doctrine or rule, and he makes nothing of it and will not let it stand up as a gift (T061/T082). Two hundred and seventy-five stands exact, complete, unspent and spoken by nobody in Sarn, Sill or Grath; six months and ninety-five days are told by nobody; the fire's fifth is unpaid the same number of days with its payer unnamed. The shelf's held beat returned at two breaths on Frost 5 stays a held change on its own place, not a fourth likeness and not a doctrine; nothing was joined, named, opened, called, paid or ended, and the file lies open on the towel with every gap left gap. Frost 10 (Day 279), the first Account-day and market of the month, stands four mornings ahead and is not brought early; the hand lays back against the fold as a man puts away a tool where the next hand will find it without looking, forward and unresolved, and the river's low note goes quiet after it.
